selected_records.title: Low-rank tensor structure of precipitation and its application to satellite-reference merging

article.body:
TMerge applies low-rank tensors to satellite precipitation data

The paper presents TMerge, a method for combining satellite precipitation estimates with sparse reference observations. It identifies no specific user group; the stated application is merging those data sources.

A joint tensor shares spatial and temporal factors between the satellite and reference data, with a source mode distinguishing them. Applied to correct IMERG Final Run using CPC reference observations over CONUS, TMerge raised correlation from 0.53 to 0.85 and reduced root-mean-square error by 48.2% and mean absolute error by 29.3% during 2019–2022.

This is a research method evaluated in a study, not evidence of a released user-facing product. Availability not specified.
